text:
609.12.2, Pipe Installation Wall Thickness, is hereby amended by the addition of the following exception:
(3) Piping insulation within an interior partition of a conditioned building can be reduced to a minimum wall thickness of one inch (1”).
(Ord. 20570 § 26, 7-1-25.)
title: 609.12.2, Pipe Installation Wall Thickness.
